New Army Chief General Dhiraj Seth Unveils 'VIJAY' Roadmap

General Dhiraj Seth has assumed office as the new Chief of Army Staff, outlining his vision named 'VIJAY'. This roadmap focuses on technological advancement, jointness among services, self-reliance ('Atmanirbharta'), and soldier welfare. The transition also involves a reshuffle in top military posts, with General Upendra Dwivedi retiring after his tenure.
